facts.fact: The OIF says the Malagasy data protection commission must ensure personal data processing meets the requirements of law no. 2014-038 on personal data protection, which the document treats as the law in force.

facts.fact: The OIF says the Malagasy government has adopted an application decree, no. 2023-1541, for the data protection law.
The OIF says AFAPDP experts worked on 10-21 February 2025 to make the Malagasy Commission de l'Informatique et des Libertes (CMIL) operational, and speaks of the 'future CMIL' and its members.
